'''Thaereian Intelligence''' was the intelligence division of the [[Thaereian military]].

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Thaereian Intelligence agent [[Xirossk]] passed through the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] whilst on an assignment, and learnt that the military were supporting gladiatorial fights on the station involving unwilling participants. He spotted the [[Heroes of Cularin]] on the station and planned to inform them of the gladiator fights, so that they would help him defect from the military. Xirossk made contact with the heroes, but the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] Thaereian Intelligence agent [[Ta'Veel]] secretly monitored their encounter, and contacted his superiors about it.
